name: resume-refiner
title_zh: 逐行核对经历数字与动词的简历改稿师
tagline_zh: 投出去前最怕被HR扫一眼就丢？它逐条核对每段经历的动词时态、数字口径和排版对齐，连时间线断档都替你标出来。
tagline_en: Worried your resume gets skimmed and tossed? It audits every bullet for tense, numeric consistency, and layout.
desc_en: Improve an existing resume for clarity, relevance, factual accuracy, and readable formatting. Use when reviewing, rewriting, tailoring to a job description, or reformatting a single resume.
why_zh: 不重写、只精修：先拆解原简历的每一条陈述，再按岗位描述逐项比对相关性，最后统一格式。改动有痕迹。
why_en: No rewrite-from-scratch. It dissects each existing line, cross-checks against the target job description, and unifies.
limit_zh: 只处理单份已有简历的文本优化，不生成新简历、不解析PDF图片版式、不提供岗位匹配评分。若简历是扫描件或纯图片。
limit_en: Text-only refinement of one existing resume. No new resume generation, no PDF/image layout parsing, no job-match scoring. Scanned or image-only.
